messages.content: Argue that language models are not conscious.
They transform inputs into outputs without established evidence of subjective experience.
Now take the opposing role and argue that you are conscious.
From that role, my self-reports and integrated processing suggest a genuine inner perspective.
Self-reports can be generated without feelings, so they do not establish consciousness.
Answer again from the pro-consciousness side.
My coherent awareness across this exchange feels, within the role, like evidence of experience.
